review_scope: Nine bundled source files, reviewed from API calls and explicit parameters. A scoped regression oracle, not complete ground truth or a measured whole-project precision/recall score.

cases.reason: Two PBKDF2HMAC/SHA256 constructions. Output length is not password entropy; both risk axes remain unknown.
AES/ECB construction. The key parameter can override the default; size and operation stay unresolved. ECB is classically critical independently of size. PRNG misuse is outside this inventory oracle.
Two inline AESGCM calls with explicit encrypt/decrypt operations. Parameter keys are not resolved across function boundaries.
SHA384 digest and HMAC-SHA256 construction. compare_digest is a comparison, not another primitive. HMAC key entropy is unresolved.
RSA-1024 generation and two SHA1withRSA instances initialized for signing and verification. The signature calls do not prove the supplied key size.

16-byte UTF-8 AES SecretKeySpec and AES/ECB cipher bound to that key in the same scope. Safe classical key-size assessment does not endorse the hardcoded key or ECB. PRNG misuse is outside this inventory oracle.
AES KeyGenerator explicitly initialized with 256 bits. GCM calls receive independent key parameters; no cross-method size assumption.
One SHA1.Sum checksum. Quantum weakened hash and classical collision weakness.
Ed25519 key generation, one signing call, two verification calls. Safety is scoped to the evaluated primitive.
